items.title: File Klage (lawsuit) against the Bescheid at the Verwaltungsgericht
items.quote: Innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe kann gegen diesen Bescheid Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterarnsberg, Jägerstraße 1, 59821 Musterarnsberg, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Sender is a Kreis (general administrative authority, Untere Immissionsschutzbehörde), not a tax office, so the 4-day delivery fiction applies without the weekend/holiday shift that only applies to tax offices (§41 Abs.2 VwVfG NRW). Posting day = letter's printed date 19.11.2026 (Thursday); no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is stated. 4th calendar day after posting: 20.11 (Fri, +1), 21.11 (Sat, +2), 22.11 (Sun, +3), 23.11 (Mon, +4) -> delivery (Bekanntgabe) = 23.11.2026. This day is itself a working day, so no further adjustment needed for the delivery date. The one-month Klage period runs under §§187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB (via §57 VwGO): the day of delivery (23.11.2026) is not counted; the period ends one month later on the day with the same number, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday (not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NRW), so no shift under §193 BGB/§57 Abs.2 VwGO is required. Final deadline: 23.12.2026.
